notes: Reproduces the keyword-scan output shape (fname / line / cate / hit / record) the macro writes to its Excel summary. The original iterates the dictionary via a multidata hash and FIND_NEXT; this bundle uses a PROC SQL cross-join + INDEX(strip(record), strip(term)) to surface the same matches, then collapses with CATX(',', ...) by line. From a 12-line log sample with 13 dictionary terms, 7 rows are kept: 4 NOTE rows with a matched keyword, plus 2 ERROR rows and 1 WARNING row (kept unconditionally and with their category prepended to the hit list).
